title: Big Island Loop
placeholder: Placeholder · on hold until airfares ease
subtitle: Seven days clockwise around Hawaiʻi Island from Kona with no backtracking: Kaloko-Honokōhau on landing day, Kohala and Hāmākua, two nights at the volcano, then Kaʻū, Kahuku and the Place of Refuge on the way back to Kona.

days.title: Before the trip
days.html:
✈︎

Bay Area → KOA

Take a morning nonstop to Kona on United, Alaska or Southwest; Day 1 assumes you land around 1 PM. Hawaii doesn’t do daylight saving, so it’s 2–3 hours behind home.

Pick up the round-trip rental at KOA (Costco Travel).

Start on a Sunday so Kahuku, open Thursday–Sunday only, lands on Day 5, with Day 6 as a Friday fallback.

Once fares come down: book Kona for Nights 1 and 5–6, Hilo for Night 2 and an accessible room at Volcano Inn (or Volcano Village Lodge) for Nights 3–4. Reserve Volcano House dinner for Day 4, (808) 930-6910.

days.title: Land in Kona
days.cut: Cars at the Kaloko-Honokōhau visitor center lot must be out by 4:00 PM, so arrive by 3:15 at the latest.

days.title: Kohala, Waimea, Hāmākua
days.sub: Kona → Kawaihae → Pololū → Waimea → Waipiʻo → Hilo
days.cut: The longest driving day. Pololū is optional if you’re running late; it’s a dead end, so it costs about an hour and a half round trip.

days.title: Up to Kīlauea
days.sub: Hilo → Rainbow Falls → Hawaiʻi Volcanoes → Volcano
days.cut: Kīlauea Visitor Center is due to reopen in late 2026; if it has, the stamp moves back there from the Kilauea Military Camp Welcome Center. Several overlooks were closed for parts of 2026, so check what’s open.

days.title: Chain of Craters Road
days.sub: Volcano → Chain of Craters → Hōlei Sea Arch → Volcano
days.cut: No stamps today and no services below the summit. Bring water and food.

days.title: Kaʻū to the Place of Refuge
days.cut: Kahuku is open Thursday–Sunday only and reopened Sept 3, 2026 after hurricane damage, with upper Kahuku Road still closed. Confirm before going. Friday (Day 6) is the fallback.

days.title: Slow Kona day
days.cut: Stamp buffer: Kahuku is still open Friday if Thursday fell through, and Hōnaunau and Kaloko-Honokōhau are each under 45 minutes away.

days.title: Fly home
days.cut: Midday nonstop home. Allow time for the rental return and the open-air terminal.

stops.via: South on Queen Kaʻahumanu Hwy, half a mile north of the Honokōhau Harbor turn.
stops.name: Kaloko-Honokōhau NHP
stops.addr: Hale Hoʻokipa Visitor Center, Kaloko-Honokōhau National Historical Park, Kailua-Kona, HI

also.name: Ala Kahakai NHT
also.where: Same desk. Puʻukoholā and Hōnaunau also carry it.

stops.ok: Ancient fishponds and petroglyphs along the coast; green sea turtles often bask on the beach.
stops.about: A Hawaiian settlement on the lava coast, with fishponds, house sites and a hōlua slide.

stops.via: South into Kailua-Kona.
stops.name: Kailua Village seawall
stops.addr: Aliʻi Drive, Kailua-Kona, HI
stops.note: Dinner on Aliʻi Drive and sunset over the water.

stops.via: Up the hill.
stops.name: Kailua-Kona
stops.addr: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Kailua-Kona, 75-146 Sarona Rd, Kailua-Kona, HI
stops.note: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Kailua-Kona. Tomorrow leaves at 7:45 AM.

stops.via: North on Queen Kaʻahumanu Hwy past the resorts to Kawaihae, about 35 mi.
stops.name: Puʻukoholā Heiau NHS
stops.addr: Puukohola Heiau National Historic Site, 62-3601 Kawaihae Rd, Kawaihae, HI
stops.hrs: Daily 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM. Parking lot closes at 4:00.
stops.ok: The heiau is in view from the visitor center lanai. The paved path down is a steep climb back up, so the lanai view is plenty. Ala Kahakai stamp here too.
stops.about: The temple Kamehameha built in 1790–91 on the way to uniting the islands.

stops.via: Leave about 9:20. Hwy 270 up the Kohala coast through Hāwī.
stops.name: Pololū Valley Lookout
stops.addr: Pololu Valley Lookout, Kapaau, HI
stops.note: Roadside lookout over the valley and sea cliffs. Optional if running late.

stops.via: Leave about 10:35. Back through Hāwī, then Kohala Mountain Road over the ranchland.
stops.name: Lunch in Waimea
stops.addr: Waimea, HI
stops.note: Leave about 12:45.

stops.via: Hwy 19 east to Honokaʻa, then Hwy 240 to the end.
stops.name: Waipiʻo Valley Lookout
stops.addr: Waipio Valley Lookout, Honokaa, HI
stops.note: Overlook a few steps from parking.

stops.via: Leave about 2:00. Hwy 19 down the Hāmākua Coast.
stops.name: Onomea Scenic Drive
stops.addr: Onomea Scenic Drive, Papaikou, HI
stops.note: Four-mile rainforest loop, seen from the car.

stops.via: Back on Hwy 19 into town.
stops.name: Hilo
stops.addr: Hilo, HI
stops.note: Hotel TBD. Tomorrow starts at 8:30 AM.

stops.via: Waiānuenue Ave up from downtown.
stops.name: Rainbow Falls & Liliʻuokalani Gardens
stops.addr: Rainbow Falls, Hilo, HI
stops.note: Falls overlook beside the parking lot (rainbows on sunny mornings), then the flat paved garden paths on the bayfront.

stops.via: Leave about 10:00. Hwy 11 up through Keaʻau and Mountain View, 1.2 mi past the park entrance.
stops.name: Hawaiʻi Volcanoes NP
stops.place: Welcome Center at Kilauea Military Camp
stops.addr: Welcome Center, Kilauea Military Camp, Crater Rim Dr, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
stops.warn: Park at the ballfield, not the KMC front lot.
stops.about: Two of the world’s most active volcanoes, Kīlauea and Mauna Loa, from the summit caldera down to the sea.

stops.via: Crater Rim Drive.
stops.name: Crater Rim Drive overlooks
stops.addr: Kilauea Iki Overlook, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
stops.note: Steam Vents and Kīlauea Iki Overlook. Uēkahuna and Kīlauea Overlook were closed for parts of 2026. After dark, if Kīlauea is erupting inside Halemaʻumaʻu, come back for the glow; check USGS first.

stops.via: Out to Volcano Village.
stops.name: Volcano Village
stops.addr: Volcano Inn, 19-3820 Old Volcano Rd, Volcano, HI
stops.note: Volcano Inn (accessible room) or Volcano Village Lodge, Nights 3–4. It’s cool and damp at 3,700 ft; bring a layer.

stops.via: Chain of Craters Road from Crater Rim Drive.
stops.name: Chain of Craters Road
stops.addr: Pauahi Crater, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
stops.note: About 19 miles and 3,700 feet down to the coast, over old lava flows. Pull off at Pauahi Crater and the Kealakomo overlook.

stops.via: Down to the end of the road.
stops.name: Hōlei Sea Arch
stops.place: End of Chain of Craters Road
stops.addr: Holei Sea Arch, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
stops.note: A lava sea arch a short walk from the end-of-road parking.
stops.warn: No water, food or shade down here.

stops.via: Back up Chain of Craters Road.
stops.name: Thurston Lava Tube
stops.addr: Thurston Lava Tube, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
stops.note: Short but uneven, with steps through the tube. Easy to skip.

stops.via: Out to Volcano Village.
stops.name: Volcano Village
stops.addr: Volcano Inn, 19-3820 Old Volcano Rd, Volcano, HI
stops.note: Dinner at The Rim at Volcano House on the crater edge (reserve ahead). Tomorrow leaves at 7:30 AM.

stops.via: Hwy 11 south through Kaʻū.
stops.name: Punaluʻu Black Sand Beach
stops.addr: Punaluu Black Sand Beach, Pahala, HI
stops.note: Black sand and basking sea turtles, a short walk from parking. Give the turtles 10 feet.

stops.via: Leave about 8:45. Hwy 11 through Nāʻālehu to mile 70.5.
stops.name: Kahuku Unit
stops.addr: Kahuku Unit, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, Ocean View, HI

bonus.title: Kahuku cancellation · separate from the summit

stops.note: A former cattle ranch on the slopes of Mauna Loa. Free entry.
stops.warn: Thursday–Sunday only. Confirm it’s open before going.

stops.via: Leave about 10:05. Hwy 11 north through Ocean View, then down Hwy 160 to the coast.
stops.name: Puʻuhonua o Hōnaunau NHP
stops.addr: Puuhonua o Honaunau National Historical Park, State Hwy 160, Honaunau, HI
stops.ok: Royal grounds, Hale o Keawe and the great wall on a flat sandy path. Ala Kahakai stamp here too. Lunch nearby.
stops.about: The Place of Refuge: a sanctuary where those who broke kapu could be absolved, if they reached it.

stops.via: Hwy 11 north to Kailua-Kona.
stops.name: Kailua-Kona
stops.addr: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Kailua-Kona, 75-146 Sarona Rd, Kailua-Kona, HI
stops.note: Same hotel as Night 1, for Nights 5–6.

stops.via: Down to Aliʻi Drive.
stops.name: Hulihēʻe Palace
stops.addr: Hulihee Palace, 75-5718 Alii Dr, Kailua-Kona, HI
stops.note: The royal summer palace on the bay. Afternoon free; farewell sunset on the Kona coast, then pack.

stops.via: Up the hill.
stops.name: Kailua-Kona
stops.addr: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Kailua-Kona, 75-146 Sarona Rd, Kailua-Kona, HI
stops.note: Last night. Fly home tomorrow.

stops.title: Kona → home
stops.note: Return the rental at KOA and take the midday nonstop home.
